description: Command AI aircraft as your wing. Recruit or buy wingmen, hold ten formation shapes, and issue orders - rejoin, engage on a tether, attack your target, fall back with flares, orbit, deliver cargo, land - from the game's own radial menu, an MFD screen and the tactical map. Wingmen and their targets are marked on both the HUD and the map. EARLY DEVELOPMENT: largely AI-authored, not balanced (the shop is overpowered and will break mission difficulty), host or single-player only, and expect behaviour and config to change between versions. Feedback and bug reports very welcome.
